items.quote: Vonage APIs support different authentication methods depending on which product you are using:

items.quote: For most use-cases we recommend JWT Authentication.

items.quote: To work with our APIs, you will need to sign up for an account.
items.why: Sign-up required is part of self-serve access; free tier and pay-per-request not stated.

items.quote: We'll give you some free credit when you first open your account
items.why: Free credit on new accounts matches part of claim; self-serve gate and pricing not covered.
